db:select.doc:name: List Rules
db:select.db:sql: SELECT id, name, rule_type AS "ruleType", match_value AS "matchValue", min_urgency AS "minUrgency", enabled FROM notification_rules ORDER BY created_at

set-payload.value: #[payload map ((row) -> { id: row.id as String, name: row.name, ruleType: row.ruleType, matchValue: row.matchValue, minUrgency: row.minUrgency, enabled: row.enabled })]

db:select.doc:name: Check Duplicate Rule
db:select.db:sql: SELECT id FROM notification_rules WHERE rule_type = :ruleType AND match_value = :matchValue

raise-error.description: Já existe uma regra com este tipo e valor.

db:insert.doc:name: Insert Rule
db:insert.db:sql: INSERT INTO notification_rules (name, rule_type, match_value, min_urgency, enabled) VALUES (:name, :ruleType, :matchValue, :minUrgency, :enabled)
db:insert.db:input-parameters: #[{ name: vars.ruleInput.name, ruleType: vars.ruleInput.ruleType, matchValue: vars.ruleInput.matchValue, minUrgency: vars.ruleInput.minUrgency, enabled: vars.ruleInput.enabled default true }]

db:select.doc:name: Read Rule By Value
db:select.db:sql: SELECT id, name, rule_type AS "ruleType", match_value AS "matchValue", min_urgency AS "minUrgency", enabled FROM notification_rules WHERE rule_type = :ruleType AND match_value = :matchValue

set-payload.value: #[{ id: payload[0].id as String, name: payload[0].name, ruleType: payload[0].ruleType, matchValue: payload[0].matchValue, minUrgency: payload[0].minUrgency, enabled: payload[0].enabled }]

db:select.doc:name: Get Rule
db:select.db:sql: SELECT id, name, rule_type AS "ruleType", match_value AS "matchValue", min_urgency AS "minUrgency", enabled FROM notification_rules WHERE id = CAST(:id AS uuid)

set-payload.value: #[{ id: payload[0].id as String, name: payload[0].name, ruleType: payload[0].ruleType, matchValue: payload[0].matchValue, minUrgency: payload[0].minUrgency, enabled: payload[0].enabled }]

db:update.doc:name: Update Rule
db:update.db:sql: UPDATE notification_rules SET name = :name, rule_type = :ruleType, match_value = :matchValue, min_urgency = :minUrgency, enabled = :enabled, updated_at = now() WHERE id = CAST(:id AS uuid)
db:update.db:input-parameters: #[{ id: vars.ruleId, name: vars.ruleBody.name, ruleType: vars.ruleBody.ruleType, matchValue: vars.ruleBody.matchValue, minUrgency: vars.ruleBody.minUrgency, enabled: vars.ruleBody.enabled default true }]

db:delete.doc:name: Delete Rule
db:delete.db:sql: DELETE FROM notification_rules WHERE id = CAST(:id AS uuid)
